<!-- Rendered by the `report` stage (omni-quarto-report), which writes
     manifest.json next to this file. Its inputs are the per-dataset tables of
     the `metrics_summary` stage; every label comes from those tables. -->

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(dplyr)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(tidyr)
    library(jsonlite)
})

summaries <- unlist(fromJSON("manifest.json")$inputs$metrics_summary)

scores <- lapply(summaries, read.delim, colClasses = c(method_params = "character")) |>
    bind_rows() |>
    mutate(data = paste0(dataset_generator, "/", dataset),
           module = method,
           method = paste0(module, " ", method_params),
           k_position = factor(k_position, levels = c("k-2", "k-1", "k", "k+1", "k+2")))
```

# Summary stats

```{r}
# Total number of distinct datasets, methods and metrics
scores |>
    summarize(nDatasets = n_distinct(data),
              nMethods = n_distinct(method),
              nMetrics = n_distinct(metric))

# Number of methods and metrics per dataset
scores |>
    group_by(data) |>
    summarize(nMethods = n_distinct(method), nMetrics = n_distinct(metric)) |>
    arrange(nMethods)

# Number of datasets and metrics for each method
scores |>
    group_by(method) |>
    summarize(nDatasets = n_distinct(data), nMetrics = n_distinct(metric)) |>
    arrange(nDatasets)

# Combinations of the grid without a score
grid <- table(scores$data, scores$method, scores$metric)
w <- which(grid < 1, arr.ind = TRUE)
dn <- dimnames(grid)
data.frame(data = dn[[1]][w[, 1]], method = dn[[2]][w[, 2]], metric = dn[[3]][w[, 3]])
```

# Metrics at the true number of clusters

```{r}
#| fig.width: 10
#| fig.height: 7
#| warning: false

ggplot(scores |> filter(k_position == "k"), aes(x = method, y = score, fill = module)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, ncol = 1) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "top")
```

# Misspecifying the number of clusters

Change in each metric against the run at the true `k`. Positions that the
clustering modules clamp to `k = 2` are left out.

```{r}
#| fig.width: 10
#| fig.height: 7
#| warning: false

true_k <- scores |> filter(k_position == "k") |> select(data, method, metric, true_k = k, at_k = score)

scores |>
    inner_join(true_k, by = c("data", "method", "metric")) |>
    filter(k_position != "k",
           k == true_k + c("k-2" = -2, "k-1" = -1, "k+1" = 1, "k+2" = 2)[as.character(k_position)]) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = k_position, y = score - at_k)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = module)) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric) +
    ylab("score - score(true k)") +
    xlab("Cluster number misspecification") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
```
